findings.finding: The plan did not define a fresh live Administrator/SystemOwner recheck after runtime identity resolution and immediately before initiation persistence.
findings.required_correction: Add a Web-owned live reauthorization seam and revoked-between-checks zero-write test; retain initial and pre-publication checks.

findings.finding: Exact replay after Prepared publication or coordination phase advance was undefined even though the public idempotency requirement is not phase-qualified.
findings.required_correction: Define phase-aware replay that returns or recovers the existing prepared handoff without rerunning analysis or creating state.

findings.finding: The case-sensitive kind argument to PreparedScanIdentityBuilders.CreateDeterministicIdentity was not pinned.
findings.required_correction: Pin the kind literal, framing owner, and fixed identity vectors.

findings.finding: The configured runtime identity design lacked a replaceable internal seam for the public no-preseed vertical while retaining real production integrity checks.
findings.required_correction: Define an internal server-owned resolver abstraction with the configured implementation as the sole production default and separate composition/integrity proof.

planned_change_trigger.trigger: The plan materially changes the Scan scheduling, grouping, and retry entrance.
planned_change_trigger.implementation_intent: After corrected plan review ACCEPT and explicit user authorization, regenerate tasks and complete later gates before production writes.

rationale: The bounded architecture is viable, but task generation would otherwise invent four material security, idempotency, durability, and testability decisions.
